The author attribution and comments are retained verbatim in the source files
embedded in Kega Refusion. No upstream license grant is present in these GDAPT
files or in an umbrella LICENSE/COPYING file in the pinned GLSL repository.
This notice records provenance, not a new license grant. GDAPT is not asserted
to be GPL licensed merely because it is distributed by libretro/RetroArch.
Redistribution licensing must be clarified with the original rights holders
before treating this component as having confirmed GPL-compatible terms.

The runtime GLSL preset loader and OpenGL renderer are original Kega Refusion
implementation; no RetroArch frontend runtime code has been incorporated.
